info.title: x402-movies
info.description:
Movie catalog concierge over TMDB — search, details, and recommendations per query

Every paid route returns the purchased artifact in the 200 response body. Pay in USDC on Base or Solana — your client picks the rail.
info.x-guidance: Movie catalog concierge over TMDB — search, details, and recommendations per query. Every paid route answers an unpaid request with HTTP 402 and a list of accepted payments (USDC on Base or Solana — pick either), then returns the purchased artifact in the body of the same request once you retry with an X-PAYMENT header. Payment and delivery happen in one round trip; nothing is promised for later. GET /search ($0.001) returns matches GET /movie/:id ($0.001) returns full detail bundle (cast, providers, dates) GET /recommendations/:id ($0.002) returns ranked recs
